The '''Ebenmal system''' was located in the [[Irnaj sector/Legends|Irnaj sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]'s<ref name="OC" /> [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion.<ref name="Western Reaches" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Ebenmal]] where a [[Battle of Ebenmal|battle]] took place between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the planetoid Ebenmal was mentioned in a databank entry for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in [[2010]],<ref name="II" /> the Ebenmal system was not mentioned until an update for the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]]&mdash;an appendix provided to expand the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;was provided in [[2011]].<ref name="OC" />
